hero.title: Detect fabricated academic references
hero.subtitle: AI-generated documents often contain plausible-looking but non-existent citations. Biblio Checker verifies each reference against trusted academic databases.

fact1.title: AI fabricates plausible citations
fact1.desc: Large language models routinely generate realistic-looking references to papers and authors that do not exist.

fact2.title: Manual verification takes hours
fact2.desc: Checking dozens of references against multiple databases is slow and error-prone. Reviewers often skip it.

fact3.title: Fake citations slip through review
fact3.desc: Undetected fabricated references compromise academic integrity and erode trust in published work.

step1.title: Upload your document
step1.desc: Drop a PDF or DOCX file with a bibliography. No account needed.

step2.title: We verify each reference
step2.desc: Every citation is cross-checked against OpenAlex, SciELO, and arXiv in parallel.

step3.title: See authenticity score + evidence
step3.desc: A clear 0-100 score with per-reference verdicts, evidence, and a shareable report.
